verse.verse_1: I CALL TO WITNESS those who are sent consecutively,
verse.verse_3: And those that revive by quickening,
verse.verse_5: And those that bring down the Reminder
verse.verse_6: To end all argument or to warn.
verse.verse_7: What is promised will surely come to pass.
verse.verse_10: The mountains reduced to dust and blown away,
verse.verse_11: And when the time comes for raising the little girls (buried alive) --
verse.verse_12: For what day is that time fixed?
verse.verse_14: How will you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?
verse.verse_15: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_16: Have We not destroyed the earlier generations?
verse.verse_17: So shall We make the later ones to follow them.
verse.verse_18: That is what We shall do to those who are guilty of crime.
verse.verse_19: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from contemptible water?
verse.verse_21: Then We lodged you in a secure place (the womb)
verse.verse_23: Then We facilitated (your birth). How well do We calculate!
verse.verse_24: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a repository
verse.verse_26: For the living and the dead,
verse.verse_27: And placed in it lofty and broad stablisers, and gave you sweet water to drink?
verse.verse_28: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_29: "Go to what you used to deny;
verse.verse_30: Go to the shadow with three ramifications,
verse.verse_31: Neither shady nor protecting against the blazing Fire.
verse.verse_32: It will throw out sparks as logs of wood
verse.verse_34: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_35: They will not be able to speak that day,
verse.verse_36: Nor given leave to make excuses.
verse.verse_37: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_38: That will be the Day of Reckoning. Gathered will be (you) and the earlier (generations).
verse.verse_39: So if you have any plot to devise against Me, then devise it.
verse.verse_40: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_41: Those who take heed for themselves and fear God, will be amidst shade and springs of water,
verse.verse_42: And such fruits as they desire.
verse.verse_43: "Eat and drink with relish as reward for what you had done."
verse.verse_44: That is how We reward the good.
verse.verse_45: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_46: Eat and enjoy for a while: You are certainly sinners.
verse.verse_47: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_48: When it is said to them: "Bow in homage," they do not bow.
verse.verse_49: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
verse.verse_50: In what other lore after this will they then believe?
